limitations: Same frozen repeated-paper corpus and 12 correlated queries; no independent quality set.
Global FlatIP resident vector payload is separate from per-request temporary arrays.
SQLite route does not load global Flat; resident routes do, so process baselines differ.
Float32 candidate kernels and cutoff tie ordering differ; sequential float64 cosine only used for actual rerank.
No HNSW rebuild or subset graph in requests.
Per-request scope materialization, Flat creation/add, search, rerank, aggregation and explicit cleanup are included.
Resident Flat load and metadata initialization, query normalization, offline oracle checks excluded from query timing.
Each route runs in its own process in fixed order; matched-query differences are not interleaved causal pairs.
Untimed extra memory probes and whole-process VmHWM are not isolated allocator measurements.
Full scope experimentally combines papers and Topics, not a single public search API acceptance.
No production source/basis/incremental lifecycle, concurrency or platform acceptance.

matched_timing_differences.caveat: Fixed-order independent processes, no interleaved causal comparison.
